importanceModel.source: Supplied IQB-aligned Mathematik task bank and 2027 eA mock-exam blueprint
importanceModel.domainWeightNormalization: domain raw points / 120 BE in the supplied eA mock exam

questionInventory.selectionRule: Thirty real IQB-aligned questions per atomic topic form the Topic Quiz; two additional mapped questions are surfaced as Study Guide checks where available.
